therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: vitamin D repletion to correct deficiency
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: correction of vitamin D deficiency-related musculoskeletal symptoms
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: postmenopausal women with stage I-III breast cancer receiving letrozole who are vitamin D deficient
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: reduction in myalgias, arthralgias and/or joint stiffness after vitamin D repletion

results.effect_size: 12 participants with symptoms at baseline reduced to 1 participant at 1 month post vitamin D repletion
biomarker_changes: letrozole serum levels: median 85 μg/mL at baseline to 70 μg/mL at 1 month
